deploybot: :rocket: Production deploy started for service=inference-runtime env=prod commit=`3f8b2c9` tag=`release-3.6.0` by Anna L. Change window 02:00-03:00 UTC. Rolling 4-phase cutover. Docs: https://go/internal/releases/3.6.0
Anna L: Starting monitors and smoke checklist now. team please ack when you see green metrics. :eyes:
Jason K: ACK, running pre-cutover canary checks (latency, throughput). Will call out if anything spikes.
Priya S: I'll watch infra alarms and circuit-breaker thresholds. Oncall pager set.
Marc D: Noted. DB migrations are 0/0 (none). No feature-flag flips this rollout.
Anna L: Pinning traffic groups: inference-v2 -> release-3.6.0 (gradual 5%,25%,50%,100%)
deploybot: Canary phase complete on us-east-1: checks passed (latency p95 < 120ms, error-rate < 0.2%). Moving to foldout.
Ops Oncall: seeing a small spike in request queue depth in us-west-2 (10% above baseline) — investigating.
Jason K: Investigating a worker pool transient OOM in us-west-2, restarting pool-5 there.
deploybot: Hotfix candidate not required. Continuing rollout. Next traffic step in ~6m.
Anna L: Everyone keep an eye on latency and model cache hit-rate. If error-rate > 0.5% or p95 > 250ms we pause and rollback plan B.
Priya S: Alarm threshold crossed for queue depth -> alert routed to SRE. Ops Oncall on it.
Ops Oncall: Restarted pool-5, queue depth recovering. No user-visible errors seen. :thumbsup:
deploybot: Production deploy completed for service=inference-runtime env=prod commit=`3f8b2c9` tag=`release-3.6.0` by Anna L. All regions marked healthy. Duration 23m. :white_check_mark:
Anna L: Thank you — opening short deploy note: release-3.6.0 rolled to prod, no DB changes, no feature flags. Follow-up: postmortem template reserved (minor infra spike) and owner assigned to Jason K for 24h follow-up.
Jason K: I'll capture root cause and action items. Quick notes: investigate worker pool mem leak and add graceful backpressure.
Priya S: Will schedule a retro with SRE and runtime team.
Marc D: Pushing a telemetry alert refinement to avoid noisy alerts on transient queue hots.
Anna L: Closing thread — if anyone sees regressions please @Anna_L and put incidents in #incidents. Good job team. :party_parrot:
